title: papaver atlanticum subsp. mesatlanticum
intro: Papaver atlanticum subsp. mesatlanticum, commonly known as a subspecies of the Atlantic poppy, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Papaver atlanticum subsp. mesatlanticum have been studied for their potential in treating various conditions, including wound healing, cancer, and neurodegenerative diseases.
